executionBoundary: Only the shared host-owned Omarchy guest may execute business tools.
durabilityBoundary: Verified write-ahead frames and mandatory persistence precede every tool execution.
migrationBoundary: Explicit reviewed data import; normal startup does not discover, import, execute or modify prior homes.
rebuildBoundary: Verified RAPP/1 frames and identity are sufficient; projection databases and caches are disposable.
